about: T-579 (DRAFT): a read is fixed by the day and the place. gReadsDebugAlways 1 brings a read on every arrival, so what each one says is shown without waiting on the chance (which is drawn from the same fixed generator). ROUTE 1 twice in one session, with PALLET TOWN between; then the game saved in PALLET TOWN, ROUTE 1's read taken, the save loaded again (load + continue) and ROUTE 1 walked into once more: the same read in the same words. Then another day (DEBUG DATE: A QUIET DAY). THE SUBTLE LAYER given through DEBUG -> GAME EVENTS. The theatre's debug scratch save; nothing kept. The theatre's save has a dream waiting, which the first step after a load takes, so each load is walked off in VIRIDIAN CITY first.
